definitions.explanation: Doing a job with the hands quickly and efficiently. Most often used in the adverb form {手早|てばや}く.

examples.japanese: {手早|てばや}く⟦{片付|かたづ}ける→片付ける：01192_katazukeru⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{手早|てばや}く⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。

⟦{看護師|かんごし}→看護師：05055_kangoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{手早|てばや}い⟦{動作|どうさ}→動作：04074_dousa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{包帯|ほうたい}→包帯：05385_houtai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{巻|ま}き→巻く：02418_maku⟧、⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かった→向かう：01186_mukau⟧。
examples.english: The nurse deftly wrapped the bandage and moved on to the next patient.

notes:
Literally "quick of hand": it praises speed and skill at a practical task such as cooking, packing or first aid.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手早|てばや}く⟦{済|す}ませる→済ませる：02121_sumaseru⟧: to finish quickly
- {手早|てばや}く⟦{準備|じゅんび}する→準備する：22427_junbisuru⟧: to prepare quickly
- {手早|てばや}い⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧: quick work

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{素早|すばや}い→素早い：17093_subayai⟧: quick, agile; any fast movement or reaction, not only with the hands
- ⟦{手際|てぎわ}→手際：06657_tegiwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: skillful and efficient (at handling a job)
